strategies.label: V1 · 11 AM Close
explanation: Ranks eligible stocks by relative strength versus a 50/50 blend of SPY and the stock's sector ETF.
Requires at least 1% relative strength, positive SPY and sector returns, price above VWAP, positive 15- and 30-minute momentum, and normal-or-better volume.
Selects at most one stock; otherwise records NO_TRADE and holds cash.

strategies.label: V2 · 11 AM + Breadth
explanation: Uses every V1 rule.
Adds a prior-day breadth gate: at least 50% of 100 or more eligible stocks must be above their 20-session moving average.
If breadth data or any V1 condition fails, it records NO_TRADE and holds cash.

strategies.label: C1 · Noon Close
explanation: Uses the same stock-ranking and entry gates as V1, checked one hour later.
Selects only the top qualifying stock and exits near the same-day close.
Historical results were mixed; this remains a separate challenger and does not alter V1 or V2.

strategies.label: C2 · 11 AM Overnight
explanation: Uses the V1 ranking and entry gates at 11:00 ET.
Holds the selected stock overnight and exits at the next regular-session open.
This was the strongest historical challenger, but it carries overnight gap risk and needs prospective evidence.

strategies.label: C3 · Noon Overnight
explanation: Uses the V1 ranking and entry gates at noon.
Holds only the top qualifier overnight and exits at the next regular-session open.
It is retained for a clean timing comparison; it was less consistent than the 11:00 overnight challenger.

strategies.label: C4 · Noon Close + Breadth
explanation: Matched to C1's noon signal and same-day close.
Adds V2's lagged breadth gate: at least 50% of 100 or more eligible stocks above their 20-session average.
This isolates whether breadth improves the noon same-day schedule.

strategies.label: C5 · 11 AM Overnight + Breadth
explanation: Matched to C2's 11:00 signal and next-open exit.
Adds V2's lagged breadth gate without changing the stock-level entry rules.
This tests whether market health improves the strongest historical overnight challenger.

strategies.label: C6 · Noon Overnight + Breadth
explanation: Matched to C3's noon signal and next-open exit.
Adds the same prior-day breadth requirement used by V2, C4, and C5.
This completes the matched with-breadth versus without-breadth comparison.

strategies.label: DMAA · Dual Macro Momentum
explanation: Trades multi-asset liquid ETFs: SPY, QQQ, IWM, EFA, TLT, GLD, BIL.
Requires price above 200-day moving average and 12-month return beating T-Bills.
Ranks top 2 risk assets by blended 12m/6m/3m momentum (50% allocation each); moves sleeve to BIL/Cash when trend filters fail.
Eliminates single-stock gap risk and execution friction.
